title: Word Formation: Przedrostki dis-, mis-, over- i under- (krok 2: przedrostki)

tasks.instruction: Uzupelnij kazde zdanie jednym wyrazem, przeksztalcajac wyraz podany wielkimi literami obok luki. Kazde zdanie potrzebuje przedrostka, ktory odwraca znaczenie wyrazu. Wymagana jest calkowita poprawnosc ortograficzna.

items.sentence: I completely __________ with everything he said.
The keys always __________ when I am in a hurry.
It would be __________ to say the test went well.
Please don't __________ me - I am not angry with you.
The trains are so __________ that people wait for the next one.
Never __________ how long the journey takes in winter.
If you __________ again, you will miss the first lesson.
The __________ of antibiotics is a serious medical problem.
